## Overview

Halflings are one of the common races of Kythoria, known for their luck and their presence in trade and commerce. They follow standard Fifth Edition traits and lifespan ranges (~250 years).

---

## Origins

Like all mortal races, Halflings were created by the **Originals** (A, B, C). The gods' claim that **Crassian** created the Halflings is a calculated deception.

---

## The Claiming God (The Lie)

| God | Domains | Falsely Claims |
|-----|---------|----------------|
| **Crassian** | Wealth & Fortune | Halflings |

Crassian is the god of wealth and fortune. His church, the **Order of the Currency**, is the religious institution of merchants and bankers. His claim over the Halflings reinforces their cultural identity as lucky traders.

---

## Society & Culture

Halfling culture follows standard Fifth Edition norms. Halflings are found across Kythoria, with many involved in trade, hospitality, and agriculture. Their luck and cheerful pragmatism are valued in the harsh post-invasion world.

---

## Racial Traits

Uses standard Fifth Edition Halfling traits (Lucky, Brave, Halfling Nimbleness). No setting-specific modifications documented at this time.

---

## Social Standing

Halflings face no blame related to the divine conspiracy. Their claimed god (Crassian) is one of the seven publicly blameless gods. Halflings are generally well-liked and trusted across Kythoria.

---
